description.html: Arcadia Euro Range Forest 5% is a T8 fluorescent reptile tube from the Arcadia Euro Range, which the manufacturer describes as a high-quality, long-life, good-value series with total UVC protection and good colour rendering. The 15 W model is 450 mm long, 26 mm in diameter, with 5% UVB, 12% UVA and a 6600 K colour temperature.

UVB lets reptiles make vitamin D3 in their skin, which they need to use calcium and build healthy bones. This tube is a good choice for forest species and species that get less direct sun in the wild and do well with moderate UVB. The 5% version is the milder of the two Euro Range options; for desert species there is the Desert 10%.

Fit the tube in a T8 fixture with a ballast of the matching length, above the basking spot; a reflector increases the amount of UVB reaching the animal. Leave a shaded zone in the terrarium too. The manufacturer states that Euro Range tubes should be replaced after 9 months, because UVB fades even while the tube still lights up.
